entrypoints.summary: The report identifies stBTC.notifyRewardAmount as callable by anyone at any time and demonstrates repeated external calls.

impacts.concept: denial or delay of scheduled reward emission

relation_candidates.rationale: The finding states that any caller may invoke notifyRewardAmount at any time.
Each recomputation derives rewardRate via truncating division, and the PoC invokes it repeatedly.

relation_candidates.dst: denial or delay of scheduled reward emission
relation_candidates.rationale: The report characterizes repeated rounding as griefing/DoS and records an asset-accounting assertion mismatch after the repeated-call sequence.
The report states that minHarvestInterval removes the DoS by preventing rapid repeated calls.

impact.affected_asset: Rewards owed to stBTC vault depositors, as reflected by totalAssets reward accounting.
impact.attacker_capability: A contract user can reduce the amount scheduled for emission by repeatedly submitting reward-notification transactions.
impact.security_effect: Griefing denial or delay of significant reward emission through repeatable rounding loss.

causal_trace.summary: An arbitrary contract user may invoke the unprotected reward-notification function at chosen times.

Each reward-rate recomputation uses integer division of rewardBalance by REWARDS_DURATION, discarding the remainder from the scheduled rate; repeated recomputation prevents the intended full reward balance from being scheduled across the period.
The PoC advances time by five seconds and calls notifyRewardAmount repeatedly for seven days, repeatedly realizing rate-rounding loss.
The embedded assertion observes totalAssets below deposits plus the expected one ether of emitted rewards, supporting griefing/denial of significant scheduled reward emission.

failure.operation: Repeated permissionless notifyRewardAmount calls recompute rewardRate using truncating division.

primary_invariant.statement: Reward balances intended for a reward period must be represented in the scheduled reward emission such that vault assets include deposited assets and emitted rewards.
primary_invariant.violated_because: Permissionless repeated rate recomputation truncates rewardBalance modulo REWARDS_DURATION each time, excluding remainders from the recomputed rate.

raw_refs.role: canonical audit finding and embedded PoC

quality.review_notes: The public audit report supplies the finding narrative, a Foundry-style PoC, an assertion/revert trace, and a stated fix commit. No immutable affected source snapshot, resolved fa0411bf diff, or independently runnable environment is present; remediation implementation and execution cannot be independently confirmed from this bundle.

remediation.invariant_restored: Rate recomputation is constrained so rapid attacker-driven recomputation cannot repeatedly discard substantial reward remainders; remaining rounded amounts are emitted later according to the report.

state_context.attacker_state_setup: The report PoC deposits into the vault, funds the fee receiver with one ether, invokes fee harvesting, then repeatedly advances time and calls notifyRewardAmount.
data_structure_invariants: The duration-based reward rate should account for rewards intended to emit during the reward period.
The report's test expects totalAssets to include the initial deposit and all emitted rewards.

numeric_domains.attacker_constraints: Attacker must be able to submit repeated notification transactions during the reward period; the PoC uses five-second spacing.
numeric_domains.name: rewardBalance / REWARDS_DURATION
numeric_domains.width: uint256 (inferred from report's Solidity PoC and identifiers; exact declaration unavailable)

state_context.state_machine: Harvested rewards are distributed into a reward balance, then notifyRewardAmount recomputes a duration-based emission rate; harvest moves scheduled rewards into vault assets.

oracle.expected_negative: A mitigation that enforces the documented minimum harvest interval should prevent rapid repeated notification; the report suggests varying minHarvestInterval in the supplied test to evaluate scenarios.
oracle.expected_positive: Under the malicious five-second repeated-notify sequence, the vulnerable accounting assertion comparing totalAssets with INITIAL_DEPOSIT plus one ether fails with the reported lower totalAssets value.
